library(dplyr)
library(abdiv)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)

fix_path <- function(path){
  os_type <- Sys.info()["sysname"]
  if (os_type == "Windows"){
    path <- gsub("/rsrch5", "//d1prprsh5ccifs", path)
  } else{
    path <- gsub("//d1prprsh5ccifs", "/rsrch5", path)
    path <- gsub("B:/", "/rsrch5/home/trans_mol_path/cercan/", path)
  }
  return(path)
}



spatial_folder = fix_path("B:/BE_master/3.integration/integration_project/spatial_analysis/")
integration_project_path =file.path(spatial_folder,"tabular/merged/")

region_level <- readRDS(file.path(integration_project_path,"region_level_250527.RDS"))

region_level_edit <- region_level %>%
  select(-starts_with("Dens.")) %>%
  select(-matches("Num.*_area")) %>%
  mutate(Num.LymphoPlasma = Num.Lymphocyte + Num.Plasma,
         Num.Immune = Num.Lymphocyte + Num.Plasma + Num.Neutrophil + Num.Eosinophil)



  
# for(location in c("stroma", "epithelium")){
  # for(cell_type in c("Lymphocyte", "Plasma","LymphoPlasma", "Eosinophil", "Neutrophil")){
    immune_classes <- c("Num.Immune", "Num.LymphoPlasma", 
                    "Num.Lymphocyte", "Num.Plasma")

 
    # target_colname=paste0("Dens.",cell_type,"_stroma")
    # cell_colname = paste0("Num.",cell_type)
    
    region_level_edit <- region_level_edit%>%
      mutate(across(all_of(immune_classes),
                ~ . / Area.um.2_stroma_area,
                .names = "Dens_{.col}"))%>%
      rename_with(~ sub("^Dens_Num.", "Dens_", .), starts_with("Dens_Num"))


    
             

region_level_edit <- region_level_edit%>%
      mutate(Dens.Epithelial = Num.Epithelial / Area.um.2_epithelium_area)

immune_classes <- c("Num.Immune", "Num.Lymphocyte", 
                    "Num.Plasma", "Num.LymphoPlasma")

# Create a new data frame with Morisita calculations
morisita_data1 <- region_level %>%
  filter(attention_score >= 0.5) %>%
  group_by(wsi, progression, flow, pred, dataset) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(immune_classes), 
                   ~ horn_morisita(Num.Epithelial, .), 
                   .names = "Morisita_{col}_attn1"), 
            .groups = 'drop')%>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^Morisita_Num.", "Morisita_", .), starts_with("Morisita_Num"))


morisita_data2 <- region_level %>%
  # filter(attention_score >= 0.5) %>%
  group_by(wsi, progression, flow, pred, dataset) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(immune_classes), 
                   ~ horn_morisita(Num.Epithelial, .), 
                   .names = "Morisita_{col}_attn2"), 
            .groups = 'drop')%>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^Morisita_Num.", "Morisita_", .), starts_with("Morisita_Num"))


morisita_data0 <- region_level %>%
  filter(attention_score < 0.5) %>%
  group_by(wsi, progression, flow, pred, dataset) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(immune_classes), 
                   ~ horn_morisita(Num.Epithelial, .), 
                   .names = "Morisita_{col}_attn0"), 
            .groups = 'drop')%>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^Morisita_Num.", "Morisita_", .), starts_with("Morisita_Num"))

morisita_data <- left_join(morisita_data1,morisita_data0,morisita_data2, by=c("wsi", "progression", "flow", "pred", "dataset"))
remove(morisita_data1,morisita_data0,morisita_data2)


write.csv(morisita_data, file.path(spatial_folder,"tabular/calculated/morisita.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
morisita_data <- morisita_data%>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c("progression", "flow", "pred","dataset")),
                ~ factor(.)))

morisita_column_set <- colnames(morisita_data)[6:length(morisita_data)]


symnum.args <- list(cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
                     
#pred 1, co 0vs1 (attn 0,1)

plot_folder = paste0(spatial_folder,"plot/morisita/COvsNCO/")
dir.create(plot_folder, recursive = T)


morisita_data %>%
  drop_na(progression) %>%
  filter(pred == 1) %>%
  select(progression, starts_with("Morisita")) %>%  # Select progression and Morisita columns
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Morisita"), names_to = "Morisita_Type", values_to = "Value") %>%  # Reshape data
  group_by(Morisita_Type) %>%  # Group by Morisita type
  group_map(~ {
  
    p <- ggplot(.x, aes(x = progression, y = Value, color = progression)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label.x.npc = "centre", symnum.args = symnum.args) +
      theme_light() +
      labs(title = .y, y = "Morisita")  
    
    ggsave(paste0(plot_folder,.y,"_absolute_wholedataset",".pdf"), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6)
    return(p)
  }) -> plots

# To display the plots
for (plot in plots) {
  print(plot)
}

plot_folder = paste0(spatial_folder,"plot/morisita/attn0vs1/")
dir.create(plot_folder, recursive = T)

morisita_data %>%
  select(pred, ends_with("_attn0"), ends_with("_attn1")) %>%  # Select relevant columns
  pivot_longer(cols = -pred, names_to = c("_", "cell","attn"), names_sep = "_",values_to = "Morisita")%>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c("cell", "attn")),
                ~ factor(.)))%>%
  group_by(cell,pred)%>%
  group_map(~ {
    p <- ggplot(.x,aes(x=attn, y=Morisita, color = attn))+
      geom_boxplot() +
      stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label.x.npc = "centre", symnum.args = symnum.args, paired = TRUE) +
      theme_light() +
      labs(title = paste0(.y$cell, "_", .y$pred), y = "Morisita")
    
    ggsave(paste0(plot_folder,.y$cell,"_absolute_",.y$pred,".pdf"), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6)
    return(p)
    })

find_neighboring_regions <- function(df, tile_size=112) {
  filtered_df <- df%>%
  filter(attention_score >= 0.5 )
  
  x = filtered_df$Centroid.X.px
  y = filtered_df$Centroid.Y.px
  
  neighbors <- data.frame(Centroid.X.px = numeric(), Centroid.Y.px = numeric())


  for (i in -1:1) {
    for (j in -1:1) {
      # if (i == 0 && j == 0) {
      #   next
      # }

      x_neighbor <- x + i * tile_size
      y_neighbor <- y + j * tile_size

      neighbor <- data.frame(Centroid.X.px = x_neighbor, Centroid.Y.px = y_neighbor)

      neighbors <- rbind(neighbors, neighbor)
    }
  }
  neighbors <- distinct(neighbors)
  neighbors$neighbor_attn <- 1
  df <- left_join(df, neighbors, by = c(\Centroid.X.px\, \Centroid.Y.px\)) %>%
  mutate(neighbor_attn = if_else(is.na(neighbor_attn), 0, neighbor_attn))


  return(df)
}


find_and_summarize_neighboring_regions <- function(df, tile_size = 112) {
  # Filter the dataframe based on attention_score
  filtered_df <- df %>%
    filter(attention_score < 0.5 & neighbor_attn == 0)
  
  # Generate all neighbor offsets for a 3x3 grid (including self)
  neighbor_offsets <- expand.grid(i = -1:1, j = -1:1) %>%
    mutate(neighbor_dx = i * tile_size, neighbor_dy = j * tile_size) %>%
    select(neighbor_dx, neighbor_dy)

  # Join filtered_df with neighbor_offsets to generate all neighbors for each region
  neighbors <- filtered_df %>%
    crossing(neighbor_offsets) %>%
    mutate(
      Neighbor.X.px = Centroid.X.px + neighbor_dx,
      Neighbor.Y.px = Centroid.Y.px + neighbor_dy
    ) %>%
    select(Image, Neighbor.X.px, Neighbor.Y.px)
  
  # Fetch remaining columns from the main dataframe using a join to complete neighbor information
  neighbor_data <- neighbors %>%
    left_join(filtered_df, by = c(\Image\ = \Image\, \Neighbor.X.px\ = \Centroid.X.px\, \Neighbor.Y.px\ = \Centroid.Y.px\)) %>%
    filter(neighbor_attn == 0)

  # Summarize neighboring regions by image
  summarized_df <- neighbor_data %>%
    group_by(Image) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with(\Num.\), sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    left_join(df %>% select(Image, flow, pred, progression), by = \Image\)
  
  summarized_df$Image <- as.factor(summarized_df$Image)
  df$Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma <- df$Num.Lymphocyte + df$Num.Plasma

  summarized_df <- df %>%
    group_by(Image, flow, pred,progression) %>%
    filter(Num.Epithelial > 0) %>%
    filter(Num.Plasma > 0 | Num.Lymphocyte > 0) %>%
    summarise(
      Morisita_lymph = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte), method = \morisita\),
      Morisita_detection = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Detections), method = \morisita\),
      Morisita_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Plasma), method = \morisita\),
      Morisita_lymph_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma), method = \morisita\),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )

  return(summarized_df)
}

```r

find_neighboring_regions <- function(df, tile_size=112) {
  filtered_df <- df%>%
  filter(attention_score >= 0.5 )
  
  x = filtered_df$Centroid.X.px
  y = filtered_df$Centroid.Y.px
  
  neighbors <- data.frame(Centroid.X.px = numeric(), Centroid.Y.px = numeric())


  for (i in -1:1) {
    for (j in -1:1) {
      # if (i == 0 && j == 0) {
      #   next
      # }

      x_neighbor <- x + i * tile_size
      y_neighbor <- y + j * tile_size

      neighbor <- data.frame(Centroid.X.px = x_neighbor, Centroid.Y.px = y_neighbor)

      neighbors <- rbind(neighbors, neighbor)
    }
  }
  neighbors <- distinct(neighbors)
  neighbors$neighbor_attn <- 1
  df <- left_join(df, neighbors, by = c(\Centroid.X.px\, \Centroid.Y.px\)) %>%
  mutate(neighbor_attn = if_else(is.na(neighbor_attn), 0, neighbor_attn))


  return(df)
}


find_and_summarize_neighboring_regions <- function(df, tile_size = 112) {
  # Filter the dataframe based on attention_score
  filtered_df <- df %>%
    filter(attention_score < 0.5 & neighbor_attn == 0)
  
  # Generate all neighbor offsets for a 3x3 grid (including self)
  neighbor_offsets <- expand.grid(i = -1:1, j = -1:1) %>%
    mutate(neighbor_dx = i * tile_size, neighbor_dy = j * tile_size) %>%
    select(neighbor_dx, neighbor_dy)

  # Join filtered_df with neighbor_offsets to generate all neighbors for each region
  neighbors <- filtered_df %>%
    crossing(neighbor_offsets) %>%
    mutate(
      Neighbor.X.px = Centroid.X.px + neighbor_dx,
      Neighbor.Y.px = Centroid.Y.px + neighbor_dy
    ) %>%
    select(Image, Neighbor.X.px, Neighbor.Y.px)
  
  # Fetch remaining columns from the main dataframe using a join to complete neighbor information
  neighbor_data <- neighbors %>%
    left_join(filtered_df, by = c(\Image\ = \Image\, \Neighbor.X.px\ = \Centroid.X.px\, \Neighbor.Y.px\ = \Centroid.Y.px\)) %>%
    filter(neighbor_attn == 0)

  # Summarize neighboring regions by image
  summarized_df <- neighbor_data %>%
    group_by(Image) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with(\Num.\), sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    left_join(df %>% select(Image, flow, pred, progression), by = \Image\)
  
  summarized_df$Image <- as.factor(summarized_df$Image)
  df$Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma <- df$Num.Lymphocyte + df$Num.Plasma

  summarized_df <- df %>%
    group_by(Image, flow, pred,progression) %>%
    filter(Num.Epithelial > 0) %>%
    filter(Num.Plasma > 0 | Num.Lymphocyte > 0) %>%
    summarise(
      Morisita_lymph = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte), method = \morisita\),
      Morisita_detection = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Detections), method = \morisita\),
      Morisita_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Plasma), method = \morisita\),
      Morisita_lymph_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma), method = \morisita\),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )

  return(summarized_df)
}

```r
```r
ggplot(collected_files_NU_rectangle, aes(x = attention_score, weight = Num.Lymphocyte, color = progression)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, position = \identity\, alpha=0.5)  +
  geom_density(aes(y =  ..count..*0.15), alpha = 0.07)+
  labs(x = \Attention Score\, y = \Total Cell Count\, fill = \Progression\, color = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal()


collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(flow == \1\) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = attention_score, weight = Num.Lymphocyte, color = progression)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, position = \identity\, alpha=0.5)  +
  geom_density(aes(y =  ..count..*0.15), alpha = 0.07)+
  labs(x = \Attention Score\, y = \Total Cell Count\, fill = \Progression\, color = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal()

collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(flow == \1\ & pred ==\1\) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = attention_score, weight = Num.Lymphocyte, color = progression)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, position = \identity\, alpha=0.5)  +
  geom_density(aes(y =  ..count..*0.15), alpha = 0.07)+
  labs(x = \Attention Score\, y = \Total Cell Count\, fill = \Progression\, color = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal()
```

collected_files_NU_rectangle%>%
  filter(neighbor_attn == 1 | attention_score >= 0.5 )%>%
  filter(Num.Lymphocyte >0 & Num.Epithelial >0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = Num.Lymphocyte, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE)


collected_files_NU_rectangle%>%
  filter( pred ==\1\) %>%
  filter(neighbor_attn == 1 | attention_score >= 0.5 )%>%
  filter(Num.Lymphocyte >0 & Num.Epithelial >0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = Num.Lymphocyte, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE)


collected_files_NU_rectangle%>%
  filter( pred ==\1\) %>%
  filter(neighbor_attn == 1 | attention_score >= 0.5 )%>%
  filter(Num.Plasma >0 & Num.Epithelial >0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = Num.Plasma, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  geom_violin()

collected_files_NU_rectangle%>%
  filter(neighbor_attn == 1 | attention_score >= 0.5 )%>%
  filter(Num.Plasma >0 & Num.Epithelial >0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = Num.Plasma, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE)



<!-- rnb-output-end -->

collected_files_NU_rectangle%>%
  filter(neighbor_attn == 1 | attention_score >= 0.5 )%>%
  filter(Num.Lymphocyte >0 & Num.Epithelial >0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = Num.Lymphocyte, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE)


collected_files_NU_rectangle%>%
  filter( pred ==\1\) %>%
  filter(neighbor_attn == 1 | attention_score >= 0.5 )%>%
  filter(Num.Lymphocyte >0 & Num.Epithelial >0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = Num.Lymphocyte, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE)


collected_files_NU_rectangle%>%
  filter( pred ==\1\) %>%
  filter(neighbor_attn == 1 | attention_score >= 0.5 )%>%
  filter(Num.Plasma >0 & Num.Epithelial >0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = Num.Plasma, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  geom_violin()

ggplot(collected_files_NU_rectangle, aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Lymphocyte), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()

```r

ggplot(collected_files_NU_rectangle, aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Lymphocyte), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()


collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(flow == \1\ ) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Lymphocyte), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()

  
  
  
  collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(flow == \1\ & pred ==\1\) %>%
    ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Lymphocyte), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()
  
  collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter( pred ==\1\) %>%
    ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Lymphocyte), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()
  
```

collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(attention_score >= 0.5 ) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Lymphocyte), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()


collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(flow == \1\ &attention_score >= 0.5 ) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Lymphocyte), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()

  
  
  
  collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(flow == \1\ & pred ==\1\&attention_score >= 0.5) %>%
    ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Lymphocyte), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()

    
  collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter( pred ==\1\&attention_score >= 0.5) %>%
    ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Lymphocyte), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()

```r

collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(attention_score >= 0.5 ) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Lymphocyte), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()


collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%

  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()

collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(attention_score >= 0.5 ) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Plasma), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()

```r

collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(attention_score >= 0.5 ) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Plasma), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()


collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(flow == \1\ &attention_score >= 0.5 ) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = as.factor(progression), y = attention_score, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(aes(scale = Num.Plasma), adjust = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.25, color = \black\) +
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Attention Score\, fill = \Progression\) +
  stat_compare_means(method = \wilcox.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))+
  theme_minimal()

plot_function <- function(df, lastname = NULL, aneuploid_filter = NULL , collumn = \Morisita_lymph\){
  if (!is.null(lastname)){
    df <- df %>%
  filter(endsWith(as.character(Image), lastname)) #\ROI0.tif\
  }
  
  if (!is.null(aneuploid_filter)){
    df <- df %>%
  filter(!!sym(aneuploid_filter) == 1) #\ROI0.tif\
  } else {
    aneuploid_filter <- \whole dataset\
  }
  
  plot <-df%>%
    drop_na(progression)%>%
ggplot( aes(x = progression, y = !!sym(collumn), fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5)) +  # Add p-value from +
  ggtitle(paste(aneuploid_filter, collumn,lastname, sep= \ \))
print(plot)
}

  if (!is.null(lastname)){
    df <- df %>%
  filter(endsWith(as.character(Image), lastname)) #\ROI0.tif\

  if (!is.null(aneuploid_filter)){
    df <- df %>%
  filter(!!sym(aneuploid_filter) == 1) #\ROI0.tif\
  } else {
    aneuploid_filter <- \whole dataset\
  }
  
  plot <-df%>%
    drop_na(progression)%>%
ggplot( aes(x = progression, y = !!sym(collumn), fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5)) +  # Add p-value from +
  ggtitle(paste(aneuploid_filter, collumn,lastname, sep= \ \))
print(plot)
}

ggplot(collected_files_NU_rectangle_morisita, aes(x = progression, y = Morisita, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))  # Add p-value from

  filter(flow == 1)%>%

  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))  # Add p-value from

ggplot(collected_files_NU_rectangle_morisita, aes(x = progression, y = Morisita, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))  # Add p-value from


collected_files_NU_rectangle_morisita %>%
  filter(flow == 1)%>%
ggplot( aes(x = progression, y = Morisita, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))  # Add p-value from

collected_files_NU_rectangle_morisita %>%
  filter(pred == 1)%>%
ggplot( aes(x = progression, y = Morisita, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +

collected_files_NU_rectangle$wsi <- as.factor(substr(collected_files_NU_rectangle$Image, 1, 5))

collected_files_NU_rectangle_neigbour_morisita <- collected_files_NU_rectangle %>%
  filter(neighbor_attn == 1) %>%
  group_by(wsi, progression, Image, flow, pred) %>%

```r
ggplot(collected_files_NU_rectangle_neigbour_morisita, aes(x = progression, y = Morisita, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))  # Add p-value from


collected_files_NU_rectangle_neigbour_morisita %>%
  filter(flow == 1)%>%
ggplot( aes(x = progression, y = Morisita, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))  # Add p-value from

collected_files_NU_rectangle_neigbour_morisita %>%
  filter(pred == 1)%>%
ggplot( aes(x = progression, y = Morisita, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))  # Add p-value from

collected_files_NU_rectangle_neigbour_morisita$Image <- as.character(collected_files_NU_rectangle_neigbour_morisita$Image)
collected_files_NU_rectangle_neigbour_morisita%>%
  filter(endsWith(Image, \ROI0.tif\)) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = progression, y = Morisita, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
    labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
    theme_minimal() +
    stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))  # Add p-value from

  filter(endsWith(Image, \ROI0.tif\)) %>%
  filter(flow == 1)%>%

  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution

  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))  # Add p-value from

```r
collected_files_NU_rectangle_neigbour_morisita$Image <- as.character(collected_files_NU_rectangle_neigbour_morisita$Image)
collected_files_NU_rectangle_neigbour_morisita%>%
  filter(endsWith(Image, \ROI0.tif\)) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = progression, y = Morisita, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
    labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
    theme_minimal() +
    stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))  # Add p-value from


collected_files_NU_rectangle_neigbour_morisita %>%
  filter(endsWith(Image, \ROI0.tif\)) %>%
  filter(flow == 1)%>%
ggplot( aes(x = progression, y = Morisita, fill = as.factor(progression))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +  # Use trim = FALSE to show the full distribution
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = \crossbar\, width = 0.5, color = \black\, size = 0.5, aes(group = progression)) +  # Add median bar
  labs(x = \Progression\, y = \Morisita Index\, fill = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = \t.test\, label = \p.signif\,  position = position_nudge(x = 0.5))  # Add p-value from

collected_files_MDA_rectangle %>%
  drop_na(progression)%>%
ggplot( aes(x = attention_score, weight = Num.Lymphocyte, color = progression)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, position = \identity\, alpha=0.5)  +
  geom_density(aes(y =  ..count..*0.15), alpha = 0.07)+
  labs(x = \Attention Score\, y = \Total Cell Count\, fill = \Progression\, color = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal()


collected_files_MDA_rectangle %>%
  drop_na(progression)%>%
  filter(flow == \1\) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = attention_score, weight = Num.Lymphocyte, color = progression)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, position = \identity\, alpha=0.5)  +
  geom_density(aes(y =  ..count..*0.15), alpha = 0.07)+
  labs(x = \Attention Score\, y = \Total Cell Count\, fill = \Progression\, color = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal()

collected_files_MDA_rectangle %>%
  drop_na(progression)%>%
  filter(flow == \1\ & pred ==\1\) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = attention_score, weight = Num.Lymphocyte, color = progression)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, position = \identity\, alpha=0.5)  +
  geom_density(aes(y =  ..count..*0.15), alpha = 0.07)+
  labs(x = \Attention Score\, y = \Total Cell Count\, fill = \Progression\, color = \Progression\) +
  theme_minimal()

diploid_find_and_summarize_neighboring_regions <- function(df, tile_size = 112) {
  # Filter the dataframe based on attention_score
  filtered_df <- df %>%
    filter(attention_score < 0.5 & neighbor_attn == 0)
  
  # Generate all neighbor offsets for a 3x3 grid (including self)
  neighbor_offsets <- expand.grid(i = -1:1, j = -1:1) %>%
    mutate(neighbor_dx = i * tile_size, neighbor_dy = j * tile_size) %>%
    select(neighbor_dx, neighbor_dy)

  # Join filtered_df with neighbor_offsets to generate all neighbors for each region
  neighbors <- filtered_df %>%
    crossing(neighbor_offsets) %>%
    mutate(
      Neighbor.X.px = Centroid.X.px + neighbor_dx,
      Neighbor.Y.px = Centroid.Y.px + neighbor_dy
    ) %>%
    select(Image, Neighbor.X.px, Neighbor.Y.px)
  
  # Fetch remaining columns from the main dataframe using a join to complete neighbor information
  neighbor_data <- neighbors %>%
    left_join(filtered_df, by = c(\Image\ = \Image\, \Neighbor.X.px\ = \Centroid.X.px\, \Neighbor.Y.px\ = \Centroid.Y.px\)) %>%
    filter(neighbor_attn == 0)

  # Summarize neighboring regions by image
  summarized_df <- neighbor_data %>%
    group_by(Image) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with(\Num.\), sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    left_join(df %>% select(Image, flow, pred, progression), by = \Image\)
  
  # Calculate Morisita indices (adjusted to new summarized_df)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma = Num.Lymphocyte + Num.Plasma)
  
  morisita_df <- df %>%
    group_by(Image, flow, pred, progression) %>%
    filter(Num.Epithelial > 0) %>%
    filter(Num.Plasma > 0 | Num.Lymphocyte > 0) %>%
    summarise(
      diploid_Morisita_lymph = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte), method = \morisita\),
      diploid_Morisita_detection = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Detections), method = \morisita\),
      diploid_Morisita_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Plasma), method = \morisita\),
      diploid_Morisita_lymph_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma), method = \morisita\),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )

  return(morisita_df)
}

```r

diploid_find_and_summarize_neighboring_regions <- function(df, tile_size = 112) {
  # Filter the dataframe based on attention_score
  filtered_df <- df %>%
    filter(attention_score < 0.5 & neighbor_attn == 0)
  
  # Generate all neighbor offsets for a 3x3 grid (including self)
  neighbor_offsets <- expand.grid(i = -1:1, j = -1:1) %>%
    mutate(neighbor_dx = i * tile_size, neighbor_dy = j * tile_size) %>%
    select(neighbor_dx, neighbor_dy)

  # Join filtered_df with neighbor_offsets to generate all neighbors for each region
  neighbors <- filtered_df %>%
    crossing(neighbor_offsets) %>%
    mutate(
      Neighbor.X.px = Centroid.X.px + neighbor_dx,
      Neighbor.Y.px = Centroid.Y.px + neighbor_dy
    ) %>%
    select(Image, Neighbor.X.px, Neighbor.Y.px)
  
  # Fetch remaining columns from the main dataframe using a join to complete neighbor information
  neighbor_data <- neighbors %>%
    left_join(filtered_df, by = c(\Image\ = \Image\, \Neighbor.X.px\ = \Centroid.X.px\, \Neighbor.Y.px\ = \Centroid.Y.px\)) %>%
    filter(neighbor_attn == 0)

  # Summarize neighboring regions by image
  summarized_df <- neighbor_data %>%
    group_by(Image) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with(\Num.\), sum, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    left_join(df %>% select(Image, flow, pred, progression), by = \Image\)
  
  # Calculate Morisita indices (adjusted to new summarized_df)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma = Num.Lymphocyte + Num.Plasma)
  
  morisita_df <- df %>%
    group_by(Image, flow, pred, progression) %>%
    filter(Num.Epithelial > 0) %>%
    filter(Num.Plasma > 0 | Num.Lymphocyte > 0) %>%
    summarise(
      diploid_Morisita_lymph = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte), method = \morisita\),
      diploid_Morisita_detection = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Detections), method = \morisita\),
      diploid_Morisita_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Plasma), method = \morisita\),
      diploid_Morisita_lymph_plasma = niche.overlap(cbind(Num.Epithelial, Num.Lymphocyte.Plasma), method = \morisita\),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )

  return(morisita_df)
}

```

  reshape2::melt(id=1:4)%>%
  filter(str_ends(variable, \lymph\))%>%
  mutate(variable = as.factor(variable))%>%
  mutate(progression = as.factor(progression))%>%
  ggplot( aes(x = progression,fill = variable, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    # geom_jitter(width = 0.1, position = position_jitter(0.1)) +
    # geom_line(aes(group = 1:n()), position = position_jitter(0.1)) +
    theme_minimal()

  filter(pred == 1)%>%
  reshape2::melt(id=1:4)%>%
  filter(str_ends(variable, \Morisita_plasma\))%>%
  mutate(variable = as.factor(variable))%>%
  mutate(progression = as.factor(progression))%>%
  mutate(Image = as.factor(Image))%>%
  ggplot( aes(x = progression,fill = variable, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    # geom_jitter() +
    # geom_line(aes(group=Image)) +
    theme_minimal()

```r

rectangle_wNeigbors_morisita_NU_whole %>%
  filter(pred == 1)%>%
  reshape2::melt(id=1:4)%>%
  filter(str_ends(variable, "lymph"))%>%
  mutate(variable = as.factor(variable))%>%
  mutate(progression = as.factor(progression))%>%
  ggplot( aes(x = progression,fill = variable, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    # geom_jitter(width = 0.1, position = position_jitter(0.1)) +
    # geom_line(aes(group = 1:n()), position = position_jitter(0.1)) +
    theme_minimal()

rectangle_wNeigbors_morisita_NU_whole %>%
  filter(pred == 1)%>%
  reshape2::melt(id=1:4)%>%
  filter(str_ends(variable, "Morisita_plasma"))%>%
  mutate(variable = as.factor(variable))%>%
  mutate(progression = as.factor(progression))%>%
  mutate(Image = as.factor(Image))%>%
  ggplot( aes(x = progression,fill = variable, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    # geom_jitter() +
    # geom_line(aes(group=Image)) +
    theme_minimal()
